src: const k = sketch('top'); k.rect(60, 40, { at: [0, 0] }); const t = extrude(k, 30); const sk = sketch('side', 4.1); sk.polygon([[12.4,11.6],[16.1,11.6],[14.6,16.2],[12.4,16.2]]); groove(sk, t, 360);

brep.refused: groove groove1: brep-rs cannot cut this groove yet (the tool is not fully enclosed by pull1, or its surface pair is unsupported) -- groove1 is shown without it.

truckFeatures.refusal: groove1 (groove): a ring with a slanted or curved side (a triangle, a circle, a rounded corner) is not built, because in the measurements the engine cut such rings wrongly or took minutes and the two cannot be told apart in advance; give the ring straight sides that are parallel and square to its axis.
